summary: Refactored apps/app/src/App.svelte from 363 to 225 LOC by extracting AppWorkspaceShell.svelte (196 LOC) and AppScreens.svelte (45 LOC) into apps/app/src/lib/features/shell/, preserving routing, async guards, settings persistence, titlebar, navigation, layout, and session/workspace behavior. Tests, agent-client files, and WorkspaceConfigurePanel were not modified.
decisions: Extracted workspace composition (titlebar, navigation, conversation, inspector, resizing, context menu, dialogs) into AppWorkspaceShell.svelte in apps/app/src/lib/features/shell/ to keep App.svelte as a thin product composition shell under 300 LOC.

Extracted settings and session-tree screen composition into AppScreens.svelte in apps/app/src/lib/features/shell/, exposing bind:settingsDirty and onShowWorkspaceSettings callbacks so App.svelte retains control of workspace launching.
Avoided modifying apps/app/tests/App.test.ts (999 LOC) and any agent-client implementation files or WorkspaceConfigurePanel, per the user's constraints.
